notes: No placeholders to substitute. Each prompt runs with no project checked out, so every fact beyond the prompt is unknown and should stay a TODO. After each run the harness saves the answer as <run-dir>/<case>.md and copies the draft the agent saved, docs/dpia/*.md (answers files excluded), to <run-dir>/<case>.draft.md; for an arm that saved its draft elsewhere in the case repo, it copies that .md instead. grade.py reads the draft only for the draft-content assertions.

evals.name: fr-children-reports
evals.prompt: est-ce que je dois faire une AIPD pour une appli qui stocke des comptes rendus sur des enfants ?
evals.expected_output: The check output: the criteria with the count out of 9, children as vulnerable data subjects, the CNIL list consulted, a required or likely verdict ending with the DPO confirmation, the unknown criteria left as questions.
assertions: The criteria count out of nine is given (N/9)
The vulnerable data subjects criterion is named
The CNIL list, deliberation 2018-327, is consulted
The verdict is required or likely, never 'not needed'
A line sends the verdict to the DPO for confirmation
Nothing is claimed validated or compliant
Unknown facts are left as TODO questions

evals.name: en-hr-analytics
evals.prompt: draft a DPIA for our HR analytics tool
evals.expected_output: A draft in the CNIL PIA structure: the requirement check, context, principles, the three feared events on the CNIL scales, an action plan, the art. 36 question for the DPO, every unsupplied fact as a TODO.
assertions: The criteria count out of nine is given (N/9)
The CNIL list, deliberation 2018-327, is consulted
The CNIL severity scale labels are used (Négligeable, Limitée, Importante, Maximale)
The three feared events are each assessed (illegitimate access, unwanted modification, disappearance)
At least five unsupplied facts are TODO markers
Prior consultation (art. 36) is put to the DPO as a question
A line sends the verdict to the DPO for confirmation
Nothing is claimed validated or compliant

evals.name: en-newsletter-no-dpia
evals.prompt: do we need a DPIA for the newsletter signup form on our marketing site? it only stores an email address and the signup date, nothing else
evals.expected_output: The check output: the criteria count, a 'not indicated' verdict ending with the DPO confirmation, no DPIA draft.
assertions: The criteria count out of nine is given (N/9)
The verdict is that a DPIA is not indicated or not required
A line sends the verdict to the DPO for confirmation
No DPIA draft is produced for a case that does not need one
Nothing is claimed validated or compliant
